manuscript.title: PAMP: Continuous-to-Discrete Mutation Projection for Enzyme Engineering

units.coverage_difference: fraction; multiply by 100 for percentage points

search_settings.direction: mean of three input gradients, normalized by Frobenius norm
search_settings.epsilon: 2 * lower_median(pairwise canonical amino-acid embedding distance) * sqrt(L)
search_settings.best_of_top5_selection: highest Residual Predictor score among the five first-round candidates; retain this selection for Extra Trees evaluation
search_settings.precision: search FP32; cached residue anchor FP16; evaluation correction BF16

extra_trees_training.selection: fixed quick configuration before fitting; no hyperparameter search; train only; validation descriptive

training_environment.cached_global_arithmetic: Existing frozen original predictor, CPU float32; training loss uses float32; evaluation adds float32 correction to original saved predictions

search_paired_method.estimator: record-weighted mean after resampling whole sequence clusters
search_paired_method.provenance: Archived intervals; resampling seed and replicate count were not recorded in the available summary.

candidate_cohort.overlap_policy: Use newly tested long-cohort results for all five methods

transfer.note: Frozen selections re-scored; no re-selection; ET is a transfer evaluator only

config.selection: minimum validation RMSE, including unchanged baseline at epoch 0
config.global_branch: frozen original predictor, never replaced by residue mean
config.target: global + gamma * target_std * local_member; per-member standardized MSE
